findings.note: Listed as a co-sponsor of HB 1246, Safeguarding Elections Act (introduced and referred to Rules 08/04/2026). Bill text makes it a Class 2 misdemeanor to demand citizenship documentation from a voter other than what state law requires at any point in voting, and also covers observers and election-worker intimidation. Co-sponsor status taken from the bill page sponsor list; primary sponsors are Buansi, Dahle, F. Jackson, Clark.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (House vote 66-47, passed)
findings.note: Voted no on second reading of HB 958, a bill making many election-law changes. The ratified text includes a requirement that the State Board of Elections create a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database, plus voter-roll deceased checks and drivers-license office registration citizenship questions. Amendment votes the same day were not read for content and are not saved.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, motion 11 (concur in Senate version) (House vote 62-47, passed)
findings.note: Voted no on the final concurrence vote on HB 958 (bill page: https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958). Ratified text includes a State Board of Elections removal process for voters flagged as non-citizens by a federal database.
